description: Reliance Industries reported record quarterly revenue growth in Q2FY27, with revenue from operations rising to ₹3,32,861 crore. Net profit attributable to owners increased 40.64% year on year to ₹25,548 crore, while EBITDA grew 23.9% to ₹62,409 crore.
